title: Define business concepts with Pages (Beta)
body: You can now use Pages to give business terms, acronyms, and KPIs a single governed definition. Part of [Unity Catalog semantics](/aws/en/uc-semantics), Pages form the human-modeled layer of the [Genie Ontology](/aws/en/genie-one/chat#ontology) that Genie One draws on to ground its answers. See [Pages](/aws/en/uc-semantics/pages).
